notes.title: May 15 Update
notes.notes:
[b]Hey, Golden Lap enjoyers![/b]

ℹ️ After learning that some of you were having trouble with the Cinderella Story achievement, we decided to revise the requirements. Going forward, to unlock the achievement, your team must finish a season at least 5 places higher in the team standings than they were in the previous season. If you already have the achievement, don't worry, it will remain unlocked.

⚠️ [b]A quick reminder for modders:[/b] Before publishing your mod or reporting bugs, please resolve any errors and warnings to ensure a smoother experience for everyone. In the recent updates, we've made several improvements to debug, so if your mod is already published, it's still worth checking it with the latest build.

✨ Over the past month, your incredible feedback has helped us resolve a ton of major issues in Golden Lap. [b]We truly appreciate your support - thank you so much! [/b]💖

You can check out all new fixes and improvements below:

[h2]250514_3ee835a7 Changelog[/h2]

[b]Gameplay Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] changed requirements for the Cinderella Story achievement to "Finish a season at least 5 places higher in the team standings than in the previous season"
[/list]
[b]UI Improvements[/b]

[*] tyre bar in tuning panel now blinks before the first send out in Quali

[*] improved tooltip text for sabotage and report fraud when the spy action is not available
[*] quit dialog in Quali and Race now mentions that you'll lose Quali / Race progress
[*] updated in-game feedback form
[/list]
[b]Localization Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] fixed various localization issues in all languages
[/list]
[b]Mod Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] decade set in mods can now be in the range 1000-9990
[*] decade set in mods is now rounded down to be divisible by 10
[*] updated starting resources suggested by debug when first season team members are set up
[*] added a new debug check for duplicate team member names
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] drives no longer lose a lap when a red flag happens while there are cars in pit lane
[*] game speed is now correctly restored after player cars exit the pit in Race
[*] Tuning Master and Power Hungry traits now correctly increase points range when tuning

notes.title: SPY UPDATE IS NOW LIVE! + SALE 🥳
notes.notes:
[h2]Exciting news! The Spy Update is finally here![/h2]

Inspired by thrilling events from the 70s, the spy feature lets you send a spy to another team to sabotage the opponent or steal their best parts. But be careful - if your spy is caught, you’ll face penalties!

In addition to the new features, we've made significant balance changes and enhancements. We've limited part building to one per race weekend, ramped up the aggression of AI drivers, and increased the chance of team members "partying too hard" the night before a race.

ℹ️ The Spy Update levels the playing field, helps underdog teams compete, makes late game more competitive, and provides opportunities to spend your extra budget or playfully disrupt other teams.

🎁 [b]To mark the occasion, we're celebrating this major release with a special sale! Enjoy 20% off Golden Lap until March 20th.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052040/Golden_Lap/

notes.title: SPY UPDATE 🚨 Public Beta
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, Golden Lap enjoyers![/b]

[b]We’ve got fantastic news for you this week! The next major update is finally here![/b]

[h2]Introducing the Spy Update[/h2]

Inspired by thrilling events from the 70s, the spy feature lets you send a spy to another team between race weekends. Your spy can then sabotage one of your opponent's parts or copy a design to get you a powerful part for free.

But be careful! If your spy is caught or your stolen part is reported as fraudulent, you’ll face penalties!

Both players and AI can send spies. You can deploy a spy once per race weekend and up to twice per season. Sending a spy costs $10 of your team’s budget.

Along with the new features, we're making other noteworthy balance changes and enhancements, including ramping up the aggression of AI drivers and limiting the building of parts to one per race weekend.

The Spy Update levels the playing field, helping underdog teams compete, making late game more competitive, and providing opportunities to spend your budget late in the game or playfully disrupt other teams.

ℹ️ These changes will significantly alter the game’s balance. To ensure everything is top-notch in the main releases, we'll start by sharing the Spy Update on the public beta branch. 

[b]✨ Your input is essential for refining the new features, so please try the Spy Update, complete a few seasons, and let us know what you love and what you'd like to see changed. We greatly value your feedback! 🙏[/b]

⚠️ As always, remember to backup your save data before trying the beta builds. If you experience a game-breaking bug, please avoid using the in-game report form. Instead, collect your save files and the error logs and send them directly to us by email or on Discord (for the file locations, see the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2052040/discussions/0/4839770694277730277/]How to Report a Bug[/url] post).

notes.title: Spinning Wheel Hotfix
notes.notes:
[b]Happy New Year, Motorsport Fans! 🥳 We hope you had wonderful holidays! ✨[/b]

To kick off 2025, we've prepared a neat little update for you. This hotfix (build version 250109_b2843fa9 on Windows and 250113_b2843fa9 on Mac) resolves issues causing the spinning wheel loading animation to get stuck on screen when you load a saved career with mods. With this update, any save data affected by this issue should now load seamlessly.

If the spinning wheel loading animation is still getting stuck for you even after installing this update, please reach out to our team directly via email or on Discord, and we'll look into your issue ASAP.

notes.title: Part Builder Hotfix
notes.notes: Following yesterday's update, some players reported difficulties with building new parts or that parts could be built for free. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. This hotfix (build v241213_97364011) addresses and resolves these issues. We hope you have a fantastic weekend! 🎉

notes.title: Team Member Market Update
notes.notes:
📢 Get ready for a massive treat! From making the AI more competitive to a major overhaul of the team-building process, there's so much to explore in this week's update!

🥳 Thanks to the feedback from our awesome community, we were able to polish all new features. Now both the main and public-beta branches will have the latest and the greatest of Golden Lap!

🎁 But don't worry if you love to be on the cutting edge! Just for you we're already cooking up a new secret feature, so stay tuned for the next beta update!


[h2]v241212_ab9835a6 Changelog[/h2]

ℹ️ As always, if any of the issues we resolved in this update are still happening for you, please contact the team via email and provide as much information about the issue as possible. We'll be happy to investigate further! For more information, see the pinned post [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2052040/discussions/0/4839770694277730277/]How to Report a Bug[/url].

[h3]Gameplay Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] a complete overhaul to the Team Member Market; teams will now pick their members based on their current position in the leaderboard (the first team picks first, the second team picks second, etc.)
[*] at the start of next season you can now secure the team members from the previous season
[*] you can now save and quit during the team member selection during pre-season
[*] AI drivers now turn engine mode Push more often and try to use up most of their fuel
[*] more improvements to overtake logic
[/list]
[h3]Localization Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] added Turkish localization
[*] fixed issues with French and German localization
[*] small fixes and improvements across all localizations
[/list]
[h3]Mods Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] added team BFC textures to the BaseMod (BFC was previously available in the alpha preview of Golden Lap)
[*] improved handling of drivers with the 'DecadeStartContent' value set to true
[*] you can now set the 'DecadeStartContent' value for modded engineers and crew chiefs
[*] improved AI decision making when hiring drivers for modded teams
[*] improved animations for modded teams
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] the in-game feedback form no longer remains stuck on screen in certain cases
[*] fixed the "super driver bug" (where the stats of some drivers change after restarting the game)
[*] drivers in their Last Year now retire at the end of a season even if they were not on a team
[*] fixed various issues with team member progression between seasons affectings their stats and cost
[*] fixed issues with Golden Tune sponsor challenges not being awarded in certain cases
[*] fixed Tuning Master trait working only in first race weekend of the season
[*] fixed issues with Exacting and Sloppy Crew Chief traits
[*] fixed misc issues with team member traits
[*] fixed issues with car and part building animations
[*] fixed UI issues in results screens and standings
[*] fixed various UI issues caused by team and team member names longer than 14 characters
[*] fixed wet range indicator in tire tooltip showing incorrect range in certain cases
[*] loading screen now adapts to screen size
[*] optimized error logging to avoid occasional stutter or freezes on older systems
[*] erroneous event notifications during yellow flags are no longer triggered
[*] fixed UI issues caused by applying settings and changing localization
[*] fixed issues caused by using the Back button on some screens
[/list]

notes.title: December 5 update
notes.notes:
📢 This week we're continuing with the changes to the overtake functionality. In addition to more improvements during the Qualifying, this update will reduce the likelihood of extremely slow "trains" forming during the Race while still keeping overtakes challenging. 

🙏 Thanks to the bug reports you sent us, we were also able to resolve some issues with the new Tune and Send Out functionality in the Qualifying. As a result, the feature is now part of the main game.

[h3]v241205_f985c799d Changelog[/h3]

[b]Gameplay Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] if drivers get stuck in traffic during Qualifying, they now ask the player to time next pit exit better
[*] separated Tune and Send Out actions in Qualifying, so it's easier to avoid getting stuck in traffic (to get Clean Air)
[/list]
[b]Localization Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] fixed issues with French localization displaying other languages in some parts of the UI
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]

[/list]

notes.title: Overtakes Hotfix 1
notes.notes:
While we're still working on the upcoming major update and fancy new features 🌟 , we noticed that many of you had drivers getting stuck together and losing a lot of time during the Qualifier. We just released a small update ([i]build version 241129_d1a9eb788[/i]) in order to resolve the issue.

Please let us know how you like the change! We'd love to see your feedback!

notes.title: October 18 update
notes.notes:
This week we're rolling out our first major update to enhance game balance. We've refined the overtaking mechanic, making races more challenging and putting greater emphasis on getting clean air during Qualifier, and making Qualifier placement now have more weight.

We've made significant improvements to how traits are managed in the background. While we've addressed the "super driver bug" (where drivers gain or lose focus at season's end), it's not completely resolved yet. We're prioritizing this issue and will do our best to fix it ASAP.

In the meantime, we've launched a Public Beta branch where you can get an early look at the upcoming updates. The current public beta build includes improvements to how crash chances are handled when pushing. This will prevent the possibility to constantly push throughout the whole race without consequences.

[h3]v241018_859d613 Changelog[/h3]

[b]Gameplay Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] It's more difficult to overtake now.
[*] Improved trait handling from race to race.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with saving/loading traits.
[*] Fixed blocky shadows behind some panels.
[*] Petrol Crisis achievement can no longer be unlocked if the driver doesn't finish the race.
[*] Fixed an issue where Patriotic trait was active for multiple countries.
[*] Fixed Patriotic trait not working for Eduardo Ortiz.
[*] Fixed an issue where drivers don't pit after a puncture if they get a puncture in pit lane.
[*] Accidentally clicking Back button with both right and left mouse buttons no longer soft locks the game.
[/list]

notes.title: October 10 update
notes.notes:
This week we've prepared for you a substantial update addressing several community feedback points. Some of the highlights include changes to red flag rules, better AI tyre strategy, and mod support for customizing the point-scoring system and season monetary rewards. We hope you enjoy it!

[h3]Changelog v241009[/h3]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed driver’s stress bar filling up during pit stops 
[*] Drivers can no longer get punctures in the pitlane
[*] Fixed “Lord of the pits” achievement not being unlockable. The progression of the pitstop-time-based achievements is now 8s, 6s, 5s
[*] Fixed “Home Sweet Home” achievement not being unlockable
[*] Fixed the “Patriotic” trait not working for some drivers
[*] Fixed “Steady hands” crew chief trait not working as intended (being a variant of “Risk taker” instead of its opposite)
[/list]
[b]Gameplay Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Red flag change: all drivers keep running until the leader has stopped on the start/finish line. This avoids some drivers getting penalized if they were following a car but that car had crossed the start/finish line when the red flag came out
[*] Red flag is now 8 mins to allow all the cars to complete the required laps while lining up behind the leader on the start/finish line.
[/list]
[b]AI Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved AI decisions (improved reaction times) on sudden track changes under rainy and torrential weather conditions
[/list]
[b]Modding Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Mod selection screen not automatically refreshing after downloading to a mod
[*] File loading for mods is now case-insensitive
[*] Point-scoring system and end of season monetary rewards can now be modded
[/list]
[b]UI/UX Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Added track background images in the career calendar and in the quick race track selection.
[*] Reordered end of weekend notifications: player drivers replacement, then AI drivers replacement, then sponsor challenge notification.
[*] Fixed long driver names not fitting in garage screen
[*] Visually improved the shadows behind some panels
[*] Introduced the feedback bar for Mac builds
[/list]
[b]Localization Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Small localization fixes for French, English, Italian
[/list]

notes.title: Post-release update
notes.notes:
📢 Hello, everyone! The first few days after the launch of Golden Lap have been absolutely fantastic!

🙏 [b]We're really grateful for all the love you're showing us![/b] Thanks to your feedback, we already managed to squash some impactful bugs, like issues with achievements and hiring replacement drivers (yes, Verhoeven, it's you  👀).

We released those first fixes with the new build today. You can read the changelog at the end of this announcement.

ℹ️ In the next few weeks we're committed to improve the difficulty balance and the gameplay, and make the progress from season to season more engaging. We're also adding to the game a mod debugging tool, which will help you create more robust mods.

🛠️ If you're looking for some extra thrills, check out some of the amazing mods from our community:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3341012710

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3338388066

Stay tuned for the upcoming updates! See you on the track! 🏎️💨


***

- Fixed "Golden Lap" and "Pole Position" achievements not being unlockable
